# Syno Manager

> Syno Manager is an independent app for monitoring and managing a Synology NAS (DSM 7.0 or later) from Android, iOS, macOS and Windows. It is made by MiyaraHub Technologies LLC and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Synology Inc. A one-time $9.99 purchase per platform, with no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. It connects to the NAS directly, with no server of ours in the path.

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.synomanager
- App Store (iPhone, iPad and Mac): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/syno-manager/id6763011668
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P19N2B54N1R
- Bug reports and feature requests: https://github.com/MiyaraHub/synomanager-public/issues

## Site

- [Syno Manager - App for Synology NAS on iPhone, Android, Mac](https://synomanager.com/): Monitor and manage your Synology NAS from your phone: live CPU and storage, Docker, cameras, photos, backups and an on-device assistant. $9.99, no subs.
- [Synology NAS App for iPhone & iPad - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/synology-app-for-iphone/): Monitor and manage your Synology NAS from iPhone and iPad: live readings, Docker, cameras, HEIC photos, backups, widgets and Siri. One $9.99 purchase.
- [Synology NAS App for Android - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/synology-app-for-android/): Monitor and manage your Synology NAS from Android: live readings, Docker, cameras, photos, backups, resizable widgets and launcher shortcuts. $9.99 once.
- [Synology NAS App for Mac and Windows - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/synology-app-for-mac-windows/): A native desktop app for your Synology NAS on macOS and Windows: live monitoring, Docker, backups, files with Save As, and Siri and Shortcuts on the Mac.
- [Best App for Synology NAS on iPhone, Android, Mac & PC](https://synomanager.com/best-synology-nas-app/): One app for the whole NAS instead of several: live monitoring, Docker, Package Center, cameras and backups, with a health badge that names the cause.
- [DS finder Alternative? How Syno Manager Compares](https://synomanager.com/ds-finder-alternative/): Looking beyond DS finder? Syno Manager puts Docker, Package Center, camera live view, Photos, backups and Download Station in one app. Use it next to DS finder.
- [Compatible Synology NAS Models - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/compatible-nas/): Syno Manager works with any Synology NAS on DSM 7.0 or later - DiskStation, RackStation, FlashStation and expansion units. No per-model list to check.
- [Help & Troubleshooting for Synology NAS - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/help/): Connection timeouts, certificate errors, 2FA, missing tabs, blank photo tiles, cameras failing away from home and stale widgets - what each one means.
- [Privacy - What Syno Manager Sends](https://synomanager.com/privacy/): Your NAS data never leaves your control: a direct connection, no server of ours, credentials in the keychain. Crash reports are the one thing that leaves.

## User Guide

- [Syno Manager User Guide - The Complete Manual](https://synomanager.com/guide/): The full Syno Manager manual: connect your Synology NAS, then every screen explained - system, storage, network, files, apps, media, backups and settings.
- [Docker, Packages & VMs for Synology NAS - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/apps/): Install DSM packages from Package Center, start, stop and restart Docker containers, read their logs, run Compose stacks, and control virtual machines.
- [On-Device AI Assistant for Synology NAS - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/assistant/): Ask about your Synology NAS in plain words and get the same health verdict the dashboard shows. Runs on your phone, learns from your ratings, only reads.
- [Back Up Your App Settings - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/backup-restore/): Export Syno Manager's own settings to a file and restore them on a new phone. NAS connections, passwords and sessions are deliberately never included.
- [Synology Hyper Backup Monitor on Your Phone - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/backup/): Every Hyper Backup task with the space it really takes at its destination, plus Active Backup for Business devices and deduplicated size by workload.
- [Manage Synology Users, Tasks & UPS - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/control-panel/): Manage Synology user accounts with system accounts protected, run and toggle scheduled tasks, and read UPS charge and estimated runtime from your phone.
- [Customize Cards, Tabs & Views - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/customizing/): Reorder or hide dashboard cards, choose the tabs in the bottom bar, pick which sections appear inside each tab, and collapse what you do not read.
- [Synology Download Station from Your Phone - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/downloads/): Add a link, magnet or .torrent to Synology Download Station from your phone, watch progress, and change the BitTorrent port, speed caps and destination.
- [Synology File Station, Copy & Move on Mobile - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/files/): Browse File Station, copy or move files and folders on the NAS itself including to a USB drive, manage shares, and read Note Station, Office and Contacts.
- [Connect Your Synology NAS - Syno Manager Setup](https://synomanager.com/guide/getting-started/): Add your Synology NAS in under a minute: address and port, HTTPS and self-signed certificates, QuickConnect, 2FA, and what to do when it will not connect.
- [Synology NAS Dashboard on Your Phone - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/home/): The Syno Manager home screen: a health badge that names the cause, a quick-stats row, and every dashboard card - reorder, collapse or hide any of them.
- [Synology Photos, Drive & Cameras on Mobile - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/media/): Browse Synology Photos by folder, swipe between photos full screen, on-device HEIC decoding, navigate Synology Drive, and watch Surveillance Station live.
- [Manage Multiple Synology NAS - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/multi-nas/): Add as many Synology devices as you like and switch in a tap. Each keeps its own credentials, dashboard layout, card order and collapse state.
- [Synology Network, VPN & DDNS Monitor - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/network/): Live throughput per interface, active connections and blocked IPs, DSM services you can toggle, VPN client profiles, and DDNS with your public address.
- [Access Your Synology NAS Remotely - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/remote-access/): Reach your Synology from anywhere with QuickConnect, a custom domain or a VPN. Which features work over which route, including photos and camera live view.
- [Settings, Themes & Language - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/settings/): Six accent colours or your own, AMOLED true black, dashboard cards, the bottom bar, 28 languages, launch behaviour, polling interval and temperature unit.
- [Shortcuts, Siri & Deep Links - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/shortcuts/): The synomanager:// URL scheme opens the app on any screen, and on the Mac, Siri and Shortcuts see Syno Manager natively through App Intents.
- [Synology Storage, RAID & SMART Health - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/storage/): Synology volumes and pools with RAID type and free space, per-drive SMART status and temperature, a Quick SMART Test, and safe eject for USB and eSATA.
- [Synology CPU, RAM, Temperature & Fans - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/system/): Watch CPU, RAM, load, disk I/O and temperature, change the fan speed mode, check for DSM updates, and restart or shut down your Synology from your phone.
- [Wake-on-LAN for Synology NAS - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/wake-on-lan/): Wake a sleeping Synology, or any machine on your network through it - which works from anywhere. What needs a VPN or a router forward, stated plainly.
- [Synology NAS Home Screen Widgets - Syno Manager](https://synomanager.com/guide/widgets/): Twelve widgets for Android and iOS - health, backup, temperature and fan, Docker, cameras, network, UPS, downloads, volumes and more, each timestamped.
